method: Read-only exact source audit, retained parent-built Types unit replay and separate rustc probe compiling the exact private checker Git file against public40 IR. This is an isolated actual-function reproduction, not a full Source/Types/Analyze/Verify exploit.
finding: Qualified Check::ty discards the Address mutable bit. Parameters shared &Tag plus shared &i64, with a class row for Tag and Result bound to the second input, incorrectly accept result &mut i64. Changing the second input to &mut i64 is the nearest valid declaration neighbor; both were accepted by the exact d6 checker.
required_correction: Require a mutable result to have actual matching mutable input authority in the admitted profile. A qualified class or shared stored leaf supplies no mutable target; an &mut carrier does not upgrade its shared stored leaf. Keep independent body/target proof separate.
accounting_audit_request: New actual slot/recursive pointee scans need their per-use full signature reservation at callers, beyond O(1) contract metadata counts.
limits: The prior42 unit pass is preserved and is not final acceptance of the qualified relation. Independent runtime kernels/rich source consumers were still under construction.
